name: NINEVITES
canonical: the people of Nineveh repenting, a great crowd of ancient Assyrians with bronze skin and long curled black beards, clad in sackcloth over rich layered Assyrian garments and tasseled robes, faces bowed in penitence, scattering dust and ashes upon their heads before the carved winged-bull gates of the great cruel city
notes: Pass `anchor` as --image to lock identity/world across scenes.
